name: Pause and quiet play overlay
purpose: Pause safely and change sound/help/quiet settings without losing work.
on_enter: Capture route context; stop accepting new toy contacts; resolve active contacts into paused recovery state. Pause flow, tool simulation and all audio loops.
Underlying scene remains visible with scrim; controls behind it are inert.
Quiet is a durable preference, distinct from temporarily paused play.
on_exit: On Resume, restore saved logical scene/substate and recompute input bounds; never resume volume-changing flow without explicit local resume.
persistence: settings.musicEnabled, effectsEnabled, voiceEnabled and quiet; underlying draft checkpoint. Resume does not grant rewards or alter recipes.
back_rule: Back/Escape resumes. Home checkpoints and goes02. Adult goes16 gate then returns15.
acceptance: Paused pour stays paused until player starts it; no lost volume.
Hidden-tab return does not play accumulated sounds or a large simulation dt.
implementation_notes: Quiet sets effective music off, optional particles/bloom off and nonessential motion reduced; it does not overwrite preferred music/effect/voice values. Turning quiet off restores those preferences.
Operating-system reduced-motion also reduces optional motion independently of quiet audio choices.
